scope: Parameter provenance for the two fixed source cases. Values were read from the retained source files through research/electrification/matlab_audit_20261029/audit_numeric.py:parameters(); this table records where each value comes from and whether it is measured, coded, or assumed.
real_data_status: No raw 20-lot arrival/share counts are present in this repository. The 0.09 and 42 values are source-code claims about a real fit; they are not independently verified real data here and are typed source_code, not real.

parameters.note: NB means; realised counts are sampled once and stored in the fixture.

parameters.name: power
parameters.note: Used only through the installation formula.

parameters.name: installation_cost
parameters.note: The 1.2 multiplier's physical meaning is an assumption; the arithmetic is coded.

parameters.name: amortization_years
parameters.note: Retained, not harmonised with v1's 8 years.

parameters.name: nb_variance_to_mean
parameters.note: Variance/mean ratio, not an absolute variance. NB shape mu^2/(var-mu) and p=shape/(shape+mu), as in the source.

parameters.name: beta_relative_dispersion
parameters.note: rho=Var[u]/(u(1-u)); absolute variance at target e is rho*(1-e)*e. This is NOT an absolute Beta variance of .09.

parameters.name: vot_lognormal_mu
parameters.note: The RMB/hour unit is inferred from the 6.81/60 conversion and is an assumption.

parameters.name: vot_lognormal_sigma
parameters.note: Lognormal shape on the log scale.

parameters.name: complaint_logit_alpha
parameters.note: p=1/(1+exp(alpha+beta*ln(vot))).

parameters.name: complaint_logit_beta
parameters.note: Same logit.

parameters.name: vot_draw_count
parameters.note: Permuted stratified quantiles ((i-.5)/50), one set reused across scenarios.

parameters.name: ev_fuel_unit_rate
parameters.unit: RMB per rejected EV per day

parameters.name: ice_fuel_unit_rate
parameters.unit: RMB per rejected ICEV per day

parameters.name: complaint_cost_scale
parameters.note: Multiplied by the logit probability draw.

parameters.name: time_conversion_minutes
parameters.note: The code divides by 60; the minute interpretation is inferred, not stated in the source.

parameters.name: sampling_seed
parameters.note: Python-only reproducibility seed. It is not a MATLAB/Octave common random stream.

parameters.name: sampled_days
parameters.note: Deliberately small first stage; 4 days x 21 EV-share targets. Finite-sample argmin is not an acceptance target.

parameters.name: beta_endpoint_clip
parameters.note: Mean u is clipped to [1e-4,1-1e-4] so endpoints stay non-degenerate, following audit_numeric.beta_params.

excluded_legacy_defaults.event_cost_scale_36: Not inherited. No 36 multiplier appears in the PREI reference.
excluded_legacy_defaults.absolute_beta_variance_0.09: Not inherited. 0.09 is applied as relative dispersion rho, never as absolute variance.
excluded_legacy_defaults.python_old_N_100: Not inherited. N comes from each source case (40 and 10786).
excluded_legacy_defaults.independent_logit: Not inherited. The v2 complaint probability uses the received logit on the VOT draw.
